title: Towards Inclusive NLP: Assessing Compressed Multilingual Transformers across Diverse Language Benchmarks
findings: The paper's findings focus on overall model performance, cross-lingual capabilities, and the effects of compression across various subjects. While the ArabicMMLU benchmark included 'Islamic studies', the paper does not provide a specific analysis or report findings particular to this religious subject category. The results are aggregated into broader categories like STEM, Humanities, and Social Sciences.
